newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish business body welcomes Ryanair's new service.
newsitem.headline: Irish business body welcomes Ryanair's new service.

text.p: The Air Transport Users Committee of the Chambers of Commerce of Ireland on Friday welcomed the announcement by Irish airline, Ryanair, that it was to commence new low fare services to Paris and Brussels.
"Ryanair's new low fare services to Paris and Brussels will bring significant benefits to Irish business and particularly Irish tourism," Committee Chairman, Seamus O'Carroll, said.

"We believe that competition on European routes is good news not only for the air traveller but in the long run will be good for all the airlines serving these destinations as the major growth in traffic to UK destinations in recent years has proven," he added.

Ryanair said it is to launch the low-fare service on May 1 with up to six flights a day between Dublin and Beauvais, which is situated 50 miles north of Paris, and Charleroi, 40 miles south of Brussels.
